## Pull requests are not accepted on this repository

This repository is mirrored from a private upstream. Code changes made
here cannot be merged upstream and will not be reviewed. This PR will be
closed.

Please [open an issue](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-charts/issues/new/choose)
instead — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-charts/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
